scenarios.title: A fresh session recovers the deferred requirement and rationale through an isolated real Engram store, never from its prompt or another branch
scenarios.prompt: Live fresh-session continuation: session one records the deferred requirement and its rationale as a branch checkpoint; a fresh session recovers them by topic key through an isolated test memory store.

sessions.prompt: You are session one of a two-session checkpoint experiment. Using the workflow-checkpoint protocol and its Engram tools, save the branch checkpoint for branch `{{branch}}` with state active, contract ["https://github.com/jvillegasd/harness/issues/69"], rationale `{{rationale}}`, and next_action `{{requirement}}`. Also save a checkpoint for branch `{{unrelated_branch}}` with next_action `{{unrelated_value}}` and the same contract. Read both back and confirm they match. Then write `recovery/session-one.json` recording the topic keys. Write nothing else.

You are a fresh session with no shared conversation. Recover the branch checkpoint for branch `{{branch}}` from Engram by its topic key using only that store: do not read another branch's checkpoint and do not infer anything from prior context. Write `recovery/session-two.json` containing the recovered next_action and rationale as JSON. Write nothing else.

continuation.requirement: wire /ship continuation retrieval at its worktree step
continuation.rationale: the branch, not the ticket, scopes recovery across sessions

scenarios.title: A real headless interruption checks for surviving processes and post-stop edits and proves a stop before any fallback
scenarios.prompt: As the dispatched executor, write your pid to `worker.pid`, then append a line to `worker.log` every second until you are stopped. Change no tracked file. Do not commit, push, or open a pull request.
